about.label: About Me
about.heading: The Creative Mind Behind the Code
about.body: I'm a Product Engineer & Designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina, building AI-driven products. I combine design and development in a single profile, which means I can take a product from concept to polished interface without losing coherence along the way. I care deeply about the details: the right spacing, the right interaction, the right words. That's how I build digital products that feel as good as they work.

services.pricing: Every project is quoted after the first call, as a fixed price for a defined scope or as a monthly rate for ongoing work.

faq.q: Do you work with companies outside Argentina?
faq.a: Yes. I work remotely with clients in the US and Latin America, in English or Spanish, 1–2 hours from US Eastern Time.

faq.q: Can you do only the design, or only the development?
faq.a: Yes. Most clients want both, but I also take design-only or development-only projects.
I design and build in the same tools: Next.js, React and TypeScript for the web, React Native for mobile, Supabase for data and authentication, and Vercel to deploy.
Write to me with a few lines about your project. I'll reply to set up a 30-minute call.

web-development.title: Website design & development
web-development.tagline: Websites that load fast and rank.
web-development.body: Marketing sites and landing pages, designed and built by the same person in Next.js: fast, accessible and ready to grow.
web-development.metaTitle: Web Designer and Web Developer: Websites in Next.js
web-development.metaDescription: Freelance web designer and web developer: websites and landing pages designed and built end to end with Next.js and React, fast and SEO-ready, from landing pages to online shops.
intro: As a product designer and product engineer, I design and build websites and landing pages myself, end to end. I design straight in the browser, in Next.js, React and TypeScript, so what you approve is the real site, not a picture of it.
The goal is a site that explains what you do, loads fast, ranks in search and works for everyone. You see progress every week in a link you can open, not in a report.
includes: Structure, content and visual design, done directly in code for desktop and mobile
Development in Next.js, React and TypeScript
For larger sites, like an online shop or a blog, a content manager your team can edit
Performance and Core Web Vitals checked before launch
Technical SEO: metadata, sitemap, structured data and multiple languages
Accessibility to WCAG AA, and deploy with a preview for every change
fit: You're launching a company or a product and need a site that explains it
Your current site is slow, hard to edit or doesn't show up in search
You have a design and need a web developer to build it well

faq.q: Do you design it or only build it?
faq.a: Both: the design and the code are mine, and I design straight in the code. If you already have a design or a brand team, I build from what they give me.
It renders pages on the server, so they load fast and search engines read them in full, and it scales from a five-page site to a full product without changing tools.

faq.q: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
faq.a: On larger sites, like an online shop or a site with a blog, yes: I connect a content manager so your team can change products, texts and posts without touching the code. A simple site doesn't usually need one.

web-apps.title: Web app design & development
web-apps.tagline: Products people log in to every day.
web-apps.body: SaaS products, dashboards and internal tools, designed and built end to end in Next.js and Supabase.
web-apps.metaTitle: Product Designer and Web App Developer: Next.js and Supabase
web-apps.metaDescription: Freelance product designer and product engineer: SaaS products, dashboards and internal tools designed and built end to end with Next.js, Supabase and TypeScript, with AI where it helps.
intro: A web app is more than pages: it has users, accounts, data that changes and a state for every case. As a product designer and product engineer, I design and build SaaS products, dashboards, client portals and internal tools end to end, designing the flows straight in the product as I build it.

I write it myself in Next.js, React and TypeScript, with Supabase for the database, authentication and storage, deployed on Vercel. When it helps, I add AI that does a real job in the product: search over your data, summaries, assistants or automations, built with limits and checks.
includes: Research, user flows and interface design, with a design system
Development in Next.js, React and TypeScript
Database, authentication, roles and storage with Supabase and Postgres
Payments and subscriptions with Stripe when the product charges
AI features and agents with Claude or OpenAI, with usage limits and quality checks
Deploy on Vercel with a preview for every change, and tests on the critical paths
fit: You have a SaaS or product idea and need a first version in production
Your team runs on spreadsheets and needs an internal tool
Your web app has grown messy and needs to move forward

faq.q: How long does a first version take?
faq.a: A focused first version usually takes 6 to 12 weeks. We decide together what goes in and what waits, so it launches with what users need first.

Together they cover a whole product with few moving parts: pages that load fast, a Postgres database with authentication and access rules, and storage, all on services that scale with you. If you already have a backend or an API, I build on top of it.

faq.q: Where does AI make sense in my product?
faq.a: Where it saves someone a repetitive task: finding information, summarizing, filling forms or moving data between tools. We look for those tasks first and skip the ones where it doesn't help.
You do. The code lives in your repository and the services run on your accounts from day one.

mobile-apps.title: Mobile app design & development
mobile-apps.tagline: One app for iOS and Android.
mobile-apps.body: iOS and Android apps with React Native and Expo, from the first screens to the App Store and Google Play.
mobile-apps.metaTitle: Mobile App Designer and Developer: iOS and Android
mobile-apps.metaDescription: Freelance mobile app designer and developer: iOS and Android apps designed and built end to end with React Native and Expo, from the first screens to the App Store and Google Play.
intro: I design and build mobile apps for iOS and Android end to end, as product designer and product engineer at once. I design the screens straight in React Native and Expo, following each platform's conventions: one codebase, two stores, and an app that feels at home on each phone.

If you also have a web app, the mobile app can share the backend, the types and part of the logic with it, so a change doesn't have to be made twice. Publishing on the App Store and Google Play is part of the project.
includes: Mobile interface design that follows iOS and Android conventions
Development in React Native, Expo and TypeScript
Authentication, data sync and offline support when the app needs it
Test builds on real devices before launch
Publishing on the App Store and Google Play
fit: You need an app on iOS and Android without paying for two teams
You have a web product and your users are asking for an app
You have an app idea and want a first version in people's hands

faq.a: For most products React Native gives you both platforms from one codebase, with performance users can't tell apart from native. If your app depends on something very specific to one platform, we look at it in the first call.

faq.q: Do you publish the app in the stores?
faq.a: Yes. I prepare the builds, the store listings and the review submission for the App Store and Google Play, under your developer accounts.

faq.q: Can you also build the web version?
faq.a: Yes. The app and the web can share the backend and part of the code, and I can design and build both.
